headline: Colonials Press Central Front; Wardens Hold North
war_summary: Since the last edition the central corridor has moved further toward the Colonials. In the four core regions — Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast and Endless Shore — Colonial forces now control twenty‑seven of forty‑four strategic bases, with the Dead Lands swinging to a Warden majority of eight to three while Drowned Vale (eight to four), Farranac Coast (nine to two) and Endless Shore (seven to three) remain firmly Colonial. Clahstra has fallen completely to Colonial hands, whereas Linn Mercy stays an all‑Warden stronghold; Kingscage leans Colonial seven to one and the Fingers stay contested three to four. The peripheral arcs are unchanged: Colonials hold the western and southern belt from Acrithia through Umbral Wildwood, and Wardens retain the northern and eastern stretch from Basin Sionnach to the Weathered Expanse. Base turnover in the past day was heaviest on Endless Shore (thirty‑seven changes), Drowned Vale (twenty), Farranac Coast (eighteen) and Dead Lands (nine). Casualty rates have cooled in the most recent hour but accelerated over the last two‑hour window across all hot fronts, and enlistments show the same pattern — overall decline with a sharp two‑hour uptick signalling fresh reinforcements arriving at the busiest sectors.
